lessons.trigger_condition: V390 can learn verified contribution quality and choose bounded operational goals, but repeated operational faults are not persisted as fault streaks, action choice is not stress-tested across deterministic counterfactual scoring views, and source-feature candidates do not yet carry a persistent observe-to-shadow-to-canary-spec-to-protected-PR-or-rework lifecycle.
lessons.prevention_rule: V391 must keep V390 and every prior hard gate mandatory, diagnose only operational evidence, persist bounded device-local fault streaks, stress-test V390 decisions deterministically without inventing market direction, block verified regression for non-recovery actions while never using that regression rule to block recovery, and keep source-level feature evolution non-executable until protected PR/CI plus targeted, regression, canary, runtime, integrity, alignment and actual-output validation succeed.
validation_required: functional watched-path candidate is exactly fe3e8e00f3ed5293c6d4a3834e3a6b539891a829
watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v391.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v391.py with tablet_gpt domain
tablet runtime manifest includes v391 while preserving v390 and prior controllers
self diagnosis uses operational KPI, drift, uncertainty, source health, resource and upstream gate evidence only
fault streak learning is bounded device-local operational state and never factual source truth
counterfactual stress testing is deterministic, advisory, and cannot override V390 or earlier hard gates
verified non-recovery regression can hold mutation only after minimum verified samples
recovery actions are observe-only under the V391 regression rule
source feature lifecycle remains non-executable and can move through observe, shadow spec, canary spec candidate, protected PR candidate, or rework required
source feature activation still requires protected PR/CI, targeted tests, related regression, canary, full runtime, repository integrity, Tablet GPT alignment and actual-output validation
runtime self-extension ownership remains V390 canonical V373 declarative allowlist only
market direction, facts, prices and grades are never invented
peer model weights and raw state are never imported

lessons.safety_boundary: V391 may autonomously diagnose, prioritize, stress-test, hold, re-plan and maintain non-executable feature lifecycle contracts. It does not generate or rewrite runtime source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, bypass V390/V388 or earlier verification, promote unverified facts/prices/grades, infer market direction, import peer weights/raw state, or claim physical-device success without evidence.
